races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Academy Hurdle
races.verdict: GREEN HERITAGE showed promise when third over 19f at Punchestown on debut and, open to improvement with the drop in trip likely to suit, is taken to get off the mark. Noon Blu Dodville is feared most after looking booked for second at worst when falling on debut whilst Wexford runner-up Hansel The Purse is also respected. GREEN HERITAGE (IRE) NOON BLU DODVILLE (FR) HANSEL THE PURSE (IRE)

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: SOUL ASYLUM made a promising hurdling debut when third at Wexford 28 days ago and that run may well have been needed, so he's fancied to build on that and open his account over hurdles. Look Me is of obvious interest making hurdling debut for his top yard and could be the biggest threat, while Young Rebel has something to recommend too. races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict: A strong race of its type, but PLACE DE LA NATION was the best of these over hurdles having won a Grade 1 at the Punchestown Festival on her final start and, likely to make a chaser, she holds obvious appeal. Echoing Silence may prove best of those with chasing experience, while the selection's stablemates Bambino Fever and Sainte Lucie also warrant respect on their chase bows. PLACE DE LA NATION (FR) ECHOING SILENCE (IRE) BAMBINO FEVER (IRE)

races.title: Kevin McManus Bookmaker Handicap Chase
races.verdict: KARL DES TOURELLES wasn't scoring out of turn in this sphere when landing a Galway novice chase last time and remains well treated on his best hurdling form. He can follow up back in a handicap. Rockonliam is progressive and feared most, while both the unexposed On Your Way and consistent Watch The Weather are also respected. KARL DES TOURELLES (FR) ROCKONLIAM (IRE) ON YOUR WAY (IRE)

races.title: William Hill Challenge Series Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: ROSIE'S WINGS may well have made a successful chasing debut had he not made a late mistake at Fairyhouse recently, so Ross O'Sullivan's 6-y-o earns the vote to go one better with improvement likely. Having finished runner-up on sole start in points, Kaiser de Chanay heads up the dangers on chasing bow back from 7 months off, with Some Song and Speculateur another couple worth considering, too. ROSIE'S WINGS (IRE) KAISER DE CHANAY (FR) SOME SONG (IRE)

races.title: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: LANZHOU has been going the right way since switched to handicaps, gaining a first success over hurdles last month before awarded the race on chasing debut, and he can continue his progress as he returns to hurdling. Theanniversary Man isn't taken lightly under a penalty, though, while River Vale could go well with his recent run behind him. LANZHOU (FR) THEANNIVERSARY MAN (IRE) RIVER VALE (IRE)

races.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: COCK AND BULL stepped up on his previous hurdling efforts when justifying strong support at Thurles 3 days and, with the longer trip not expected to be an issue, he looks capable of defying a 7-lb penalty and notching up a quick-fire double. King Of The Greys is another that arrives on the back of an improved win and is feared most, while the similarly unexposed pair The Rebel Fox and Tiger Twins are also capable of being involved if taking the required steps forward. COCK AND BULL (IRE) KING OF THE GREYS (IRE) THE REBEL FOX (IRE)
